_comment: PreToolUse: write-safety FLAGS (non-blocking, exit 1) Write/Edit/MultiEdit outside the cwd only during an active model-apps authoring session (a genpage-plan.md, app-spec.json, or model-app-plan.md marker at/under cwd — covering both /genpage and /app-builder); skill-pretool-telemetry emits anonymous skill_started (ships disabled until provisioned). PostToolUse: per-skill validator + on every code write validate @fluentui/react-icons imports against references/verified-icons.txt. UserPromptSubmit: emit skill_started for /model-apps:<skill> slash commands. Tracked skills are derived from skills/*/SKILL.md, so a new skill is picked up automatically. All telemetry is fail-closed and default-off in ikey.json. Run the host from the target project folder (or pass it as cwd).

hooks.command: node -e "const path=require('node:path'); const root=process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; if(!root){console.error('PLUGIN_ROOT is not set'); process.exit(0);} require(path.resolve(root,'hooks','validate-write-safety.js'));"
